\subsection*{Your turn}

\begin{itemize}

  \item a waiter, a manager, an employee, a colleague, a company

Cardboard? (\textbf{\ar{كرتون}}, \emph{kartūn}.) Bricks? (\textbf{\ar{طوب}}, \emph{ṭūb}.) Marble? (\textbf{\ar{رخام}}, \emph{rukhām}.) Rubber? (\textbf{\ar{مطاط}}, \emph{maṭṭāṭ}.) A triangle? (\textbf{\ar{مثلث}}, \emph{muthallath}.) A waiter? (\textbf{\ar{نادل}}, \emph{nādil}.) A manager? (\textbf{\ar{مدير}}, \emph{mudīr}.) An employee? (\textbf{\ar{موظف}}, \emph{muwaẓẓaf}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\ar{زميل}}, \emph{zamīl}.) A company? (\textbf{\ar{شركة}}, \emph{sharika}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
